description.en:
TORA-ONE is PaXini's wheeled humanoid manipulation platform combining visual perception with multidimensional tactile sensing. Its dexterous-hand approach uses information about contact as well as object appearance, supporting controlled grasping and interaction with items whose shape or placement can vary.

The product presentation describes object-pose recognition, positioning and force-control techniques as core capabilities. The wheeled configuration supplies mobility for moving between task locations, while the arms and hands carry out manipulation. TORA-ONE is intended as a platform for developing practical embodied-intelligence applications, with the delivered sensing, navigation and task behavior determined by its configuration and integration.
description.zh:
## 产品介绍
TORA-ONE是帕西尼面向具身智能研究与实际操作任务推出的多维触觉人形机器人，集成触觉灵巧手、AI视觉、自主导航及高精度力控。

## 产品亮点
- ��态自适应身高范围1.46至1.86米
- 含灵巧手在内共53个自由度
- 指尖力控精度0.01 N
- 集成2280个ITPU多维触觉感知单元及6840路触觉信号
- 配备5个RGB相机和2个RGBD相机
- 采用视触觉语言动作多模态模型
- 支持物体6D位姿识别与抓取
- 手臂重复定位精度±0.5毫米
- 单臂额定负载5千克，最大臂展96.5厘米
- 激光SLAM自主导航，续航最长8小时

## 应用场景
适用于医疗健康、工业制造、商业服务、精密操作及具身智能研究。
